test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the context of Chandrayaan-III mission, the SHAPE payload was used to ______.

options.text: study Earth's spectral and polarimetric properties from lunar orbit
measure thermal conductivity from lunar surface
study the plasma density on lunar surface

solution:
The correct answer is __**study Earth's spectral and polarimetric properties from lunar orbit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **SHAPE** payload stands for **Spectro-polarimetry of Habitable Planet Earth**.
 
• Unlike other payloads on the lander or rover, **SHAPE** was integrated into the **Propulsion Module** of the **Chandrayaan-3** mission.
 
• Its primary objective is to study the **Earth** from the **lunar orbit** to identify the unique **spectral and polarimetric signatures** of a habitable planet.
 
• The data collected helps scientists understand the characteristics of light reflected by **Earth**, which serves as a benchmark for searching for **habitable exoplanets** outside our solar system.
 
• It operates in the **Near-Infrared (NIR)** wavelength range, specifically from **1.0 to 1.7 μm**, to observe the disk of the Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lander Payloads (Vikram):**

 
 
• **ChaSTE (Chandra's Surface Thermophysical Experiment):** Measures the **thermal conductivity** and **temperature** of the lunar surface near the south pole.
 
• **ILSA (Instrument for Lunar Seismic Activity):** A **seismometer** designed to detect **moonquakes** and seismic vibrations around the landing site.
 
• **RAMBHA-LP (Radio Anatomy of Moon Bound Hypersensitive Ionosphere and Atmosphere - Langmuir Probe):** Analyzes the **plasma density** (ions and electrons) and its variations over time.
 
 
 
• **Rover Payloads (Pragyan):**
 
 
• **APXS (Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer):** Used to determine the **elemental composition** of the lunar soil and rocks.
 
• **LIBS (Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscope):** Employs **laser pulses** to determine the **chemical and mineralogical** composition of the lunar surface.
 
 
 
• **Mission Success:** Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed near the **Lunar South Pole** on **August 23, 2023**, making India the first country to reach this specific region.
